questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 6(2)/(5) days, B and C can do it in 7(1)/(9) days and A and C can do it in 5(1)/(3) days. If A, B and C work together, then in how many days they can finish the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of numerators of the given days (32, 64, 16) = 64 units.

Efficiency of (A + B) = 64 ÷ (32/5) = 10 units/day.

Efficiency of (B + C) = 64 ÷ (64/9) = 9 units/day.

Efficiency of (A + C) = 64 ÷ (16/3) = 12 units/day.

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = (10 + 9 + 12) ÷ 2 = 31/2 units/day.

**∴ The correct answer is 4(4)/(31) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (A + B) = 6 2/5 days = 32/5 days

Time taken by (B + C) = 7 1/9 days = 64/9 days

Time taken by (A + C) = 5 1/3 days = 16/3 days

 64 ÷ 16/3 = 12
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of 2 × (A + B + C) = 10 + 9 + 12

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 31

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 31 ÷ 2 = 31/2 units/day

⇒ Time taken by (A + B + C) to finish the work = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

⇒ Time = 64 ÷ (31/2)

⇒ Time = (64 × 2) / 31 = 128/31

⇒ 128/31 = 4(4)/(31) days

**∴ The correct answer is 4(4)/(31) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Method for Fractional Days

When time is given in fractions, you can assume the Total Work as the LCM of the numerators of the given days. This helps to avoid complex fraction additions during the intermediate calculation steps.

Combined Efficiency Rule

When combinations of two people working together are given like (A+B), (B+C), and (A+C), summing their individual efficiencies will give exactly twice the combined efficiency of all three working together [2(A+B+C)]. Always remember to divide this sum by 2.

Work and Time Relationship

Efficiency is directly proportional to Work Done and inversely proportional to the Time Taken. This can be expressed as: Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Total Time.

questions.question: An item is sold for ₹7,200 after two successive discounts of 36% and 10%. What is the marked price (in ₹) of the item?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discount ⇒ multiply remaining price factors

After 36% ⇒ 64% remains, after 10% ⇒ 90% remains

Net price factor = 0.64 × 0.90 = 0.576

So, SP = 0.576 × MP ⇒ MP = 7200 ÷ 0.576

**∴ Answer = 12500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price = 7200

Discounts = 36% and 10%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × (64/100) × (90/100)

⇒ SP = MP × (576/1000)

⇒ 7200 = MP × 0.576

⇒ MP = 7200 ÷ 0.576

⇒ MP = 12500

**∴ The correct answer is 12500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net factor = (1 − d₁/100)(1 − d₂/100)

Equivalent Discount

d = a + b − (ab/100)

Marked Price Relation

MP = SP ÷ Net factor

Quick Trick

Convert discounts to remaining % and multiply

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum rate of interest for the period from 9 February 2023 to 23 April 2023.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 19 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 23 (Apr) = 73 days.

Time (T) in years = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 years.

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

S.I. = (2000 × 7 × 1/5) ÷ 100 = 28

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,000

Rate (R) = 7% per annum

Time period = 9 Feb 2023 to 23 Apr 2023

 P = ₹2000 | R = 7% 
• 9 Feb 28 Feb 31 Mar 23 Apr 19 days 31 days 23 days 
 Total Time = 73 Days = 1/5 Year 

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (S.I.) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Days in February (2023 is non-leap year) = 28 − 9 = 19 days

⇒ Days in March = 31 days

⇒ Days in April = 23 days

⇒ Total time in days = 19 + 31 + 23 = 73 days

⇒ Time (T) in years = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 years

⇒ S.I. = (2000 × 7 × 1/5) ÷ 100

⇒ S.I. = 14000 ÷ 500

⇒ S.I. = 28

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated on the original principal only, whereas Compound Interest is calculated on the principal and the accumulated interest of prior periods.

Counting Days for Interest

When calculating interest between exact dates, either the starting date or the ending date is omitted to get the precise number of holding days.

Common Day Fractions

Standard time conversions frequently used in banking exams: 73 days = 1/5 year, 146 days = 2/5 year, 219 days = 3/5 year, and 292 days = 4/5 year.

questions.question: Two trains A and B of lengths 496 m and 490 m are running at speeds of 12 m/s and 22 m/s, respectively, towards each other on parallel tracks. In how much time will they cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add

Total speed = 12 + 22 = 34 m/s

Total distance = 496 + 490 = 986 m

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 986 ÷ 34 = 29

**∴ Answer = 29 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Train A = 496 m

Length of Train B = 490 m

Speed of A = 12 m/s

Speed of B = 22 m/s

**Formula used:**

Time = (Sum of lengths) ÷ (Relative speed)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 496 + 490 = 986 m

⇒ Relative speed = 12 + 22 = 34 m/s

⇒ Time = 986 ÷ 34

⇒ Time = 29 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 29 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add, Same direction ⇒ speeds subtract

Train Crossing

Distance covered = Sum of lengths of both trains

Basic Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Unit Consistency

Keep speed in m/s when length is in meters

questions.question: If 241 bananas were distributed among three monkeys, respectively, in the ratio (7)/(9) : (3)/(2) : (2)/(5), how many bananas did the third monkey get?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert fractional ratio to whole numbers using LCM of denominators (9,2,5) = 90

7/9 : 3/2 : 2/5 ⇒ 70 : 135 : 36

Total parts = 70 + 135 + 36 = 241

So 1 part = 1 banana ⇒ third monkey = 36

**∴ Answer = 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total bananas = 241

Ratio = (7/9 : 3/2 : 2/5)

**Formula used:**

Convert ratio into whole numbers using LCM

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 9, 2, 5 = 90

⇒ Multiply each term:

⇒ 7/9 × 90 = 70

⇒ 3/2 × 90 = 135

⇒ 2/5 × 90 = 36

⇒ Ratio becomes 70 : 135 : 36

⇒ Total parts = 70 + 135 + 36 = 241

⇒ Value of 1 part = 241 ÷ 241 = 1

⇒ Third monkey = 36 × 1 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fractional Ratio

Multiply by LCM of denominators to convert into whole-number ratio

Distribution Rule

Share = (individual part ÷ total parts) × total quantity

Shortcut Insight

If total equals sum of ratio parts, each part = 1

Common Trick

Always simplify ratio before distribution

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 15 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 24 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use relation: Q = (P×Q time relation)

P + Q = 15 hours, P = 24 hours

Q time = (P × (P+Q)) ÷ (P − (P+Q)) = (24×15)/(24−15) = 360/9 = 40 hours

Time for 1/4 work = 40 ÷ 4 = 10 hours

**∴ Answer = 10 hours**

questions.question: Eight years ago, the ratio of Aman’s age to Riya’s age was 4 : 3. Eight years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 5 : 4. What is Aman’s present age?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use ratio shift method with equal change (±8 years)

(4 : 3) → (5 : 4), both increase by +1 ⇒ base gap same

Let difference = k ⇒ (4−3)=1k and (5−4)=1k

So increase of 16 years corresponds to +k ⇒ k = 16

**∴ Aman’s present age = 4k + 8 = 64 + 8 = 72**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

8 years ago ratio = 4 : 3

8 years later ratio = 5 : 4

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations using ratio conditions

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Aman’s age 8 years ago = 4x and Riya’s = 3x

⇒ Present ages: Aman = 4x + 8, Riya = 3x + 8

⇒ After 8 years: Aman = 4x + 16, Riya = 3x + 16

⇒ (4x + 16) / (3x + 16) = 5 / 4

⇒ 4(4x + 16) = 5(3x + 16)

⇒ 16x + 64 = 15x + 80

⇒ x = 16

⇒ Present age of Aman = 4x + 8 = 64 + 8 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Ratio Shift

When equal years are added/subtracted, ratio changes but difference stays consistent

Equation Method

Use variables and solve linear equations

Cross Multiplication

Helps solve ratio equations efficiently

Common Trick

Track total years change (here 16 years) carefully

questions.question: The surface area of a sphere is 144pi square units. What is the radius of the sphere?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area of sphere = 4πr²

144π = 4πr²

Cancel 4π ⇒ r² = 36

r = √36 = 6

**∴ Answer = 6 units**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface area of sphere = 144π

**Formula used:**

Surface area = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4πr² = 144π

⇒ Divide both sides by 4π

⇒ r² = 144π ÷ 4π

⇒ r² = 36

⇒ r = √36 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

Formula = 4πr²

Volume of Sphere

Formula = (4/3)πr³

Radius from Area

r = √(Surface Area ÷ 4π)

Common Tip

π cancels out when both sides contain it

questions.question: If the HCF of two numbers is 12 and their product is 2160, what is the LCM of the two numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use relation: Product = HCF × LCM

LCM = Product ÷ HCF

= 2160 ÷ 12

= 180

**∴ Answer = 180**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF = 12

Product of numbers = 2160

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2160 = 12 × LCM

⇒ LCM = 2160 ÷ 12

⇒ LCM = 180

**∴ The correct answer is 180.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF & LCM Relation

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

HCF (Greatest Common Divisor)

Largest number dividing both numbers exactly

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

Smallest number divisible by both numbers

Quick Tip

If HCF and product are given, LCM is found directly by division

questions.question:
A spherical metallic ball of density 3.5 { gram/cm}³ has total mass 3.168 { kg} . Find the cost of painting the ball at the rate of ₹ 5.6 { per cm}² .

(Use pi = (22)/(7) , {Volume} = frac{{Mass}}{{Density}} )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert mass: 3.168 kg = 3168 g

Volume = Mass ÷ Density = 3168 ÷ 3.5 = 905.14 cm³

Use V = (4/3)πr³ ⇒ r³ = 216 ⇒ r = 6 cm

Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × 36 = 452.57 cm²

**∴ Cost = 452.57 × 5.6 ≈ ₹2534.4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Density = 3.5 g/cm³, Mass = 3.168 kg = 3168 g

Rate = ₹5.6 per cm², π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Volume = Mass ÷ Density, Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³, Surface area = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume = 3168 ÷ 3.5 = 905.14 cm³

⇒ (4/3) × (22/7) × r³ = 905.14

⇒ r³ ≈ 216

⇒ r = 6 cm

⇒ Surface area = 4 × (22/7) × 6²

⇒ = 4 × (22/7) × 36 = 452.57 cm²

⇒ Cost = 452.57 × 5.6

⇒ Cost ≈ ₹2534.4

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2534.4 (approx).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Density Formula

Density = Mass ÷ Volume ⇒ Volume = Mass ÷ Density

4πr²

1 kg = 1000 g (important before applying density)

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 47, 71, 82, 59, 22, 43, 46, 96 and 56 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean of the observations be 60.

Deviations from 60: −13, +11, +22, −1, −38, −17, −14, +36, −4.

Net deviation = (−13 + 11 + 22 − 1 − 38 − 17 − 14 + 36 − 4) = −18.

Average deviation = −18 ÷ 9 = −2.

Actual Arithmetic Mean = 60 + (−2) = 58.

**∴ The correct answer is 58.**

Weighted Average

questions.question: A person saves 60% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹560, then his income (in ₹) is:

questions.question: A car travels for 70 km at a speed of 60 km/hr, then for another 80 km at a speed of 80 km/hr, and finally for 50 km at a speed of 40 km/hr. What is the average speed of the entire journey? (Round off the answer to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 70 + 80 + 50 = 200 km

Total Time = (70 ÷ 60) + (80 ÷ 80) + (50 ÷ 40) = 7/6 + 1 + 5/4 = 41/12 hours

Average Speed = 200 ÷ (41/12) = 2400/41 = 58.536... ≈ 58.54 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 58.54 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Part 1: Distance (d₁) = 70 km, Speed (s₁) = 60 km/hr

Part 2: Distance (d₂) = 80 km, Speed (s₂) = 80 km/hr

Part 3: Distance (d₃) = 50 km, Speed (s₃) = 40 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 70 + 80 + 50 = 200 km

⇒ Time for Part 1 (t₁) = 70 ÷ 60 = 7/6 hours

⇒ Time for Part 2 (t₂) = 80 ÷ 80 = 1 hour

⇒ Time for Part 3 (t₃) = 50 ÷ 40 = 5/4 hours

⇒ Total Time = 7/6 + 1 + 5/4

⇒ Total Time = 14/12 + 12/12 + 15/12 = 41/12 hours

⇒ Average Speed = (200 × 12) ÷ 41 = 2400/41

**∴ The correct answer is 58.54 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If a certain distance is covered at speed 'x' and the same distance is covered at speed 'y', then Average Speed = (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Equal Time Intervals

If a person travels at speed 'x' for a certain time 't' and at speed 'y' for the same time 't', then Average Speed = (x + y) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (x + y). When they move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (x − y).

questions.question: A person allows a 10% discount for cash payment from the marked price of a toy and still he makes a 10% gain. What is the cost price of the toy which is marked at ₹880?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct ratio formula for Cost Price and Marked Price:

CP / MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%)

CP / 880 = (100 − 10) / (100 + 10)

CP / 880 = 90 / 110 = 9 / 11

CP = (9 / 11) × 880 = 720

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹880

Discount = 10%

Profit (Gain) = 10%

**Formulas Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

Cost Price (CP) = SP × 100 ÷ (100 + Profit%)

questions.question: What is the difference between the average of prime numbers between 60 and 70 and the average of multiples of 4 between 50 and 58?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Primes between 60–70 ⇒ 61, 67 ⇒ average = (61 + 67) ÷ 2 = 64

Multiples of 4 between 50–58 ⇒ 52, 56 ⇒ average = (52 + 56) ÷ 2 = 54

Difference = 64 − 54 = 10

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Prime numbers between 60 and 70, Multiples of 4 between 50 and 58

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of terms) ÷ Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ Prime numbers between 60 and 70 = 61, 67

⇒ Average = (61 + 67) ÷ 2 = 128 ÷ 2 = 64

⇒ Multiples of 4 between 50 and 58 = 52, 56

⇒ Average = (52 + 56) ÷ 2 = 108 ÷ 2 = 54

⇒ Difference = 64 − 54 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers

Numbers divisible only by 1 and itself (e.g., 61, 67)

Multiples

Multiples of 4: 4n (e.g., 52, 56)

Average Shortcut

For evenly spaced numbers, average = (first + last) ÷ 2

Quick Tip

Always list numbers carefully within the given range

questions.question: Simplify: sqrt{144 times 49} + sqrt{64 times 25} - sqrt{100 times 36}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Split inside root: √(a × b) = √a × √b

= √144×√49 + √64×√25 − √100×√36

= 12×7 + 8×5 − 10×6

= 84 + 40 − 60 = 64

**∴ Answer = 64**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√(144 × 49) + √(64 × 25) − √(100 × 36)

**Concept Used:**

√(a × b) = √a × √b

**Calculation:**

⇒ √(144 × 49) = √144 × √49 = 12 × 7 = 84

⇒ √(64 × 25) = √64 × √25 = 8 × 5 = 40

⇒ √(100 × 36) = √100 × √36 = 10 × 6 = 60

⇒ Expression = 84 + 40 − 60

⇒ = 124 − 60

⇒ = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root Property

√(a × b) = √a × √b

Perfect Squares

144 = 12², 49 = 7², 64 = 8², 25 = 5²

Simplification Tip

Break numbers into perfect squares for quick solving

Common Pattern

Use factorization inside root to simplify faster

questions.question:
A retailer offers the following discount schemes for buyers on an article.

I. Two successive discounts of 14%.

II. A discount of 22% followed by a discount of 29%.

III. Successive discounts of 22% and 7%.

IV. A discount of 14% followed by a discount of 6%.

Which scheme will fetch the maximum selling price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Maximum SP ⇒ Minimum discount

I: 14%, 14% ⇒ net = 1 − (0.86×0.86) = 26.04%

II: 22%, 29% ⇒ net = 1 − (0.78×0.71) = 44.62%

III: 22%, 7% ⇒ net = 1 − (0.78×0.93) = 27.46%

IV: 14%, 6% ⇒ net = 1 − (0.86×0.94) = 19.16%

**∴ Answer = Scheme IV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Four discount schemes

**Formula used:**

Net Discount = a + b − (a × b)/100

**Calculation:**

⇒ I: 14 + 14 − (14×14)/100 = 28 − 1.96 = 26.04%

⇒ II: 22 + 29 − (22×29)/100 = 51 − 6.38 = 44.62%

⇒ III: 22 + 7 − (22×7)/100 = 29 − 1.54 = 27.46%

⇒ IV: 14 + 6 − (14×6)/100 = 20 − 0.84 = 19.16%

⇒ Least discount = 19.16%

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme IV.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net = a + b − (ab/100)

Price Factor Method

Final price = MP × (1−d₁)(1−d₂)

Key Insight

Lower discount ⇒ higher selling price

Exam Tip

Compare net discounts instead of full calculation

questions.question: If 63 is the mean proportion between x and 147, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a continuous proportion, the mean proportion b = √(a × c).

Here, the mean proportion b = 63, first term a = x, and third term c = 147.

Squaring both sides gives: b² = a × c

⇒ 63 × 63 = x × 147

⇒ x = 3969 ÷ 147 = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The mean proportion between x and 147 is 63.

**Formula Used:**

If b is the mean proportion between a and c, then b² = a × c.

**Calculations:**

⇒ b² = a × c

⇒ 63² = x × 147

⇒ 3969 = 147x

⇒ x = 3969 ÷ 147

⇒ x = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportion

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is the third proportion. Formula: c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportion

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a : b :: c : d), then d is the fourth proportion. Formula: d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Duplicate & Sub-duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b². The sub-duplicate ratio is √a : √b.

questions.question: In triangle ABC , BD perp AC at D and angle DBC = 21^circ . E is a point on BC such that angle CAE = 27^circ . What is the measure of angle AEB ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In right-angled ΔBDC, ∠C = 90° − ∠DBC.

⇒ ∠C = 90° − 21° = 69°.

By the Exterior Angle Theorem in ΔACE, exterior ∠AEB equals the sum of the opposite interior angles ∠EAC and ∠C.

⇒ ∠AEB = 27° + 69° = 96°.

**∴ The correct answer is 96°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In ΔABC, BD ⊥ AC at D.

∠DBC = 21° and ∠CAE = 27°.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Since BD ⊥ AC, ΔBDC is a right-angled triangle where the sum of the acute angles is 90°.

⇒ ∠C = 90° − ∠DBC = 90° − 21° = 69°.

⇒ In ΔACE, the sum of interior angles is exactly 180°.

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − (∠CAE + ∠C)

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − (27° + 69°) = 180° − 96° = 84°.

⇒ Since B, E, and C form a straight line, ∠AEB and ∠AEC form a linear pair and are supplementary.

⇒ ∠AEB = 180° − ∠AEC = 180° − 84° = 96°.

**∴ The correct answer is 96°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles. Formula: ∠Ext = ∠Int₁ + ∠Int₂.

Angle Sum Property of a Triangle

The sum of all interior angles of a triangle is always exactly 180°. This applies to all types of triangles regardless of their shape.

Linear Pair Axiom

If a ray stands on a line, then the sum of the two adjacent angles so formed is 180°. These angles form a straight line angle.

questions.question: If three-fifths of a number is 4 more than one-half of the number, what is the number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference method: (3/5 − 1/2) of number = 4

(6 − 5)/10 = 1/10 of number = 4

So number = 4 × 10

= 40

**∴ Answer = 40**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(3/5) of a number is 4 more than (1/2) of the number

**Formula used:**

Form linear equation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ (3/5)x = (1/2)x + 4

⇒ (3/5)x − (1/2)x = 4

⇒ (6x − 5x)/10 = 4

⇒ x/10 = 4

⇒ x = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fraction Difference Trick

If a fraction of number exceeds another by a value, subtract fractions directly

LCM Method

Use LCM of denominators to simplify equations quickly

Linear Equation

Form equation and solve step-by-step

Quick Tip

Always bring fractions to common denominator first

questions.question: In an election, 60% of the total voters cast their votes. Out of these, 75% voted for candidate A and the remaining voted for candidate B. If candidate B received 7500 votes, calculate the total number of registered voters.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume total voters = 100

Votes cast = 60

B gets 25% of 60 = 15

15 corresponds to 7500

**∴ Answer = Total voters = 7500 × (100 ÷ 15) = 50000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

60% voters cast votes

Out of them, 75% voted for A

So, 25% voted for B

Votes received by B = 7500

**Formula used:**

Part = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Total

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total voters = T

⇒ Votes cast = 60% of T = 0.6T

⇒ Votes for B = 25% of 0.6T

⇒ = 0.25 × 0.6T = 0.15T

⇒ 0.15T = 7500

⇒ T = 7500 ÷ 0.15

⇒ T = 50000

**∴ The correct answer is 50000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Combine percentages: 60% × 25% = 15%

Basic Formula

Value = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Total

Assumption Method

Assume total = 100 for quick calculation

Reverse Percentage

Total = Given value ÷ percentage fraction

questions.question: A man receives ₹1,890 per month as salary. He saves 30% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total salary represents 100%.

Since the savings are 30%, the expenditure must be 100% − 30% = 70%.

Expenditure = 70% of 1890 = 0.7 × 1890.

Expenditure = 1323.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1323.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Monthly salary of the man = ₹1,890

Percentage of salary saved = 30%

 
 
 
• 
 Expenditure (70%)
 Savings (30%)
 Total Salary: ₹1890 (100%)
 ? = ₹1323
 ₹567

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Total Salary − Savings

Percentage Expenditure = 100% − Percentage Savings

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total salary = 100%

⇒ Percentage of savings = 30%

⇒ Percentage of expenditure = 100% − 30% = 70%

⇒ Total Expenditure = 70% of Total Salary

⇒ Total Expenditure = (70 ÷ 100) × 1890

⇒ Total Expenditure = 7 × 189 = 1323

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1323.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure, and Savings

The fundamental rule linking these quantities is Income = Expenditure + Savings. If any two values or percentages are known, the third can be directly derived.

Percentage Change

Percentage change = (New Value − Original Value) ÷ Original Value × 100. It is often used to calculate percentage increments in salary or budget inflations over time.

Successive Percentage Changes

The net percentage change for successive changes of a% and b% is computed using the direct formula: (a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100)%.

questions.question: The number of prime numbers between 469 and 474 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The integers between 469 and 474 are 470, 471, 472, and 473.

470 and 472 end in an even digit ⇒ Divisible by 2.

471 has a digit sum of 12 ⇒ Divisible by 3.

473 has an alternating digit sum of 4 − 7 + 3 = 0 ⇒ Divisible by 11.

Since all numbers in this range are composite, there are no prime numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The range of numbers is between 469 and 474.

**Method Used:**

Identify all integers strictly between the given numbers and check their divisibility by prime numbers up to √473 ≈ 21.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The integers strictly between 469 and 474 are: 470, 471, 472, 473.

⇒ 470 is an even number ⇒ Divisible by 2 ⇒ Not prime.

⇒ 471: Sum of digits = 4 + 7 + 1 = 12 ⇒ Divisible by 3 ⇒ Not prime.

⇒ 472 is an even number ⇒ Divisible by 2 ⇒ Not prime.

⇒ 473: Difference of sum of alternate digits = (4 + 3) − 7 = 0 ⇒ Divisible by 11 ⇒ Not prime.

⇒ None of the numbers in the given range are prime numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number

A prime number is a positive integer greater than 1 that has exactly two distinct positive divisors: 1 and itself.

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Checking Primality

To check if a number N is prime, we only need to test for divisibility by prime numbers less than or equal to √N.
</p

questions.question: If a + (1)/(a) = 6 , then find the value of a² + (1)/(a²⁾ .
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2 Here, the given value of k is 6. ⇒ a² + 1/a² = 6² − 2 ⇒ a² + 1/a² = 36 − 2 = 34 **∴ The correct answer is 34.**
